description: This Java source file defines the VisitHandler class, which manages tracking and persisting visitor and visit information within an Apache OFBiz web application. It handles session-based visit creation, visitor identification via cookies, and updates to visit and visitor data entities.

classes.name: VisitHandler
classes.description: A utility class responsible for managing user visit and visitor data, including creation, update, and retrieval of visit and visitor entities, as well as handling cookies and session state.

methods.name: setUserLogin
methods.description: Updates visit and visitor entities with user login information when a user logs in.

methods.name: getVisitId
methods.description: Retrieves the current visit ID from the session, if available.

methods.name: getVisit
methods.description: Retrieves the visit entity from the session or creates a new one if it doesn't exist, initializing it with request context info.

methods.name: getVisitor
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a visitor entity, managing cookies to identify visitors across sessions.
